posts.name: Enter Pro
posts.tagline: The AI-native platform to build and scale your apps
posts.description: Building what runs a business takes more than code. Enter Pro is the AI-native platform that turns an idea into a working product. Plan, build, preview, launch, and scale apps, websites, and custom AI agents in one continuous workspace. Models, databases, authentication, hosting, payments, analytics, and localization are built in—so teams can ship software built for real business, not just prototypes.

posts.name: Skydive
posts.tagline: Build cloud agents that work across your tools
posts.description: Build cloud agent coworkers that take on real, multi-step work across the tools you already use. Describe the outcome you want, and Skydive creates a working agent in minutes. No code, no prompt engineering, no workflow wiring required. Skydive agents live in your stack, execute repeatable work, and get sharper over time.

posts.name: Lenz
posts.tagline: Independent, multi-model fact-checking API for AI workflows
posts.description: Lenz is an AI fact-checking API for products that cannot afford to hallucinate. It extracts verifiable claims from any text, then checks each one: searching independent sources, running multi-model debate, and routing through a review panel — returning a scored verdict with every source, argument, and step visible. Most AI tools give you one model's best guess from memory. Lenz ensures no single model's blind spots drive the conclusion. Available as API and MCP. Try it free at lenz.io/ph

posts.name: Traccia
posts.tagline: Finally, a vendor-neutral AI Agent Control Plane.
posts.description: Traccia is a vendor-neutral AI Agent Control Plane built for teams running autonomous agents in production. Observe agent behavior, evaluate performance, govern actions with policies and runtime controls, and maintain an auditable trail of what happened. Built with an open, developer-first SDK and OpenTelemetry, Traccia works across models, frameworks, and existing observability stacks—so teams can control their agents without being locked into a single AI vendor.

posts.name: Gemini 3.5 Transcribe
posts.tagline: Our most precise speech-to-text model yet
posts.description: Our latest speech-to-text model designed for precise and intelligent real-time transcription.

posts.name: Speko
posts.tagline: OpenRouter for Voice
posts.description: One API for speech-to-text, language models, and text-to-speech, with public benchmarks beside runtime availability.

posts.name: Yomi
posts.tagline: A little cat who loves being read to
posts.description: Yomi is a little cat who gets fed when kids read stories aloud. Speech recognition listens along, kids can tap any tricky word to hear it, and a simple wizard lets them make up their own stories to read back. Real stories come at three levels, so kids pick what feels right today. What's not in it: streaks, ads, accounts, or data collection. No one loses a 14-day streak at bedtime. Yomi won't teach your kid to read, it gives them a reason to practice. Ages 5–9, English & Finnish, iOS.

posts.name: GitNexus (Akon Labs)
posts.tagline: The open-source kernel for coding agents
posts.description: GitNexus (45k Github stars) is a Knowledge Graph Kernel that unifies every codebase in your org into one source of truth your coding agents can query. It resolves your code into a deterministic graph, so agents get exact callers, imports, and impact instead of embedding guesses, across every repo and SCM you run. On our public benchmark (https://www.akonlabs.com/benchmarks), coding agent runs 51% cheaper with GitNexus connected. It works with any agent over MCP.

posts.name: SpacebarX
posts.tagline: A keyboard-first outliner for notes, tasks and projects
posts.description: SpacebarX is a keyboard-first, local-first outliner for notes, tasks, writing, markdown, code, and projects. Capture and organize from the keyboard, add dates inline, and let Today collect what needs attention. Search across your workspace while keeping every note in context. It works offline and syncs through a cloud folder you control. Free forever. Pro adds visual views, saved searches, encrypted documents, version restore, Calendar, uploads, and BYOK AI.

posts.name: Kira Community
posts.tagline: Curate moments with #hashtag
posts.description: Kira began as a tool for making beautiful things: turn a photo or a prompt into portraits, cinematic shots, videos. Now it's a place to share them, too. Kira Community is where your creations become moments. Tag your work with #hashtags, keep it on your profile, and browse a feed built around the themes people actually care about; and the people who care about them with you. This is Kira's first step from a tool to a community. Curate your moments, and share them with people who get it.

posts.name: Kraa 2.0
posts.tagline: Text editor and a publishing platform
posts.description: We tried to do the impossible. A text editor with clutter-free UI while being a text-editing workhorse. With a publishing platform to go with it. And voice support like you haven't seen before.

posts.name: Wondering Canvas
posts.tagline: Visual ChatGPT in Parallel
posts.description: A visual canvas of AI chat threads for understanding anything in parallel. Start a chat thread with a question and get an explanation with interactive diagrams instead of a wall of text. Spin off any key term or sentence into its own thread, ask related questions in the same canvas, and follow suggested next questions. Explore every rabbit hole while keeping your thinking organized in one place.

posts.name: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next
posts.tagline: The open-weight preview of Qwen4
posts.description: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next is a 125B multimodal MoE with only 6B active parameters and a new architecture built around QSA, Gated Residual, N-gram embeddings, and Muon. Its open weights give an early look at the architecture Qwen is building toward Qwen4.

posts.name: Sendra
posts.tagline: Design emails in Figma, export HTML that works everywhere
posts.description: Sendra is a Figma plugin that turns your email designs into clean, responsive HTML that renders in Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail and every major inbox. Select any frame you've already designed. No component library, nothing to rebuild. Per-element control over stacking, spacing and sizing on mobile, plus dark mode overrides. Every rendering rule is checked against real devices, not preview tools. Sendra hosts your images and sends a test to your inbox, so you see the real thing before shipping.

posts.name: Pluto
posts.tagline: Your professional profile is now an AI agent
posts.description: Pluto is an AI voice agent that learns your story in 10 minutes and makes you discoverable to the right people and AI agents. Most profiles reduce you to titles and keywords. Pluto learns what they miss, from what you are great at to what you want next and how you work best. It turns that understanding into a living professional profile that stays current as you do and represents the fuller picture of who you are.

posts.name: Savvy
posts.tagline: An assistant that whispers what to say during a meeting
posts.description: Savvy is a macOS meeting assistant grounded in your own documents, not the open web. Point it at a folder and it builds a versioned brief per client. In the meeting it stays quiet, then speaks up for exactly three reasons: they asked a question your brief answers, someone crossed a red line you set, or you pressed Advice. Every card cites its source. Documents, indexes and transcripts stay on your Mac; only excerpts and the audio stream leave. Apple Silicon, macOS 13+. Open source, MIT.

posts.name: The Million Sad Ducks
posts.tagline: $1 makes one of them permanently happy
posts.description: Pan and zoom the whole world for free. Pay $1 and one duck becomes permanently happy, takes the name you give it, and gets an absurdly official Certificate of Duck Happiness as a PDF. Six ponds from $1 to $1,000, depending on how dramatic you want your duck. Works as a silly gift — name the duck, and the certificate goes to whoever you're gifting it to.

posts.name: Ojin
posts.tagline: Talk to an AI Agent with a real face and voice, in real time
posts.description: Human AI Agents have a real face and a real voice, and run live conversation rather than turn-based exchange. Interrupt mid-sentence, trail off, talk over it, and the endpointing holds. Setup is one still photo, a persona and a voice. No rig, no capture session, no script. Two face models behind a single API. Portrait for scale, Presence for expressiveness. Both drop into Pipecat and LiveKit. Try to interrupt it. Most demos cannot survive that, and it is the fastest way to judge this one.

posts.name: IQ Routing
posts.tagline: Trajectory-aware LLM routing that cuts agent cost
posts.description: IQ Routing is a drop-in gateway. We classify each request, serve from cache, and route to the cheapest model that clears the quality bar and completes the task. The insight others miss: an agent is a trajectory, not a stream of independent calls. We route each step based on where it sits in the run: a cheap model on boilerplate, the strongest model on what matters.

posts.name: Eventually
posts.tagline: Your X bookmarks, emailed back as your personal newsletter
posts.description: You bookmark posts on X and never see them again. Eventually syncs those bookmarks and emails them back a few at a time, on a schedule you set. Connect X, sync, pick your rhythm, start reminders. Pause or change it anytime.

posts.name: GLM-5.3-Flash
posts.tagline: The first natively multimodal model in GLM-5 series
posts.description: GLM-5.3-Flash is the first natively multimodal model in the GLM-5 series. With 320B total parameters and just 18B active parameters, it outperforms GLM-5.2 across benchmarks and real-world workloads at one-tenth the price, while approaching Claude Opus 4.8 on coding and agentic benchmarks.

posts.name: Cobalt
posts.tagline: Your Kobo can run apps now
posts.description: Cobalt is an open-source app platform for Kobo e-readers: a launcher, a signed App Store, a Rust SDK, and a capability-isolated runtime. One USB install; every app after that arrives over Wi-Fi.

posts.name: HFlow
posts.tagline: Scalable multimodal data pipelines for robotics
posts.description: HFlow is an open source SDK for scalable multimodal data pipelines in robotics and physical AI. Define your own transforms, checks, labels, and enrichments. HFlow handles orchestration, storage, versioning, provenance, and curation, so you can inspect data quality and reproduce how each dataset was built. HFlow is built by Hebbian Robotics and is part of Y Combinator’s Summer 2026 batch.

posts.name: Ticket Fairy CLI
posts.tagline: Ticket Fairy event ticketing CLI & MCP server
posts.description: Script your event setup, exports and reporting with the Ticket Fairy CLI. Install with npm, sign in with your own account, and get stable JSON out of every command.

posts.name: DataGrout Flow
posts.tagline: Multi-step workflow orchestration with human oversight.
posts.description: AI agents running multi-step workflows have no reliable way to pause for human approval, verify a plan before it runs, or handle missing data mid-run. DataGrout Flow solves all three. Four MCP tools. Works with Claude, Cursor, or any AI agent.

posts.name: TokenGod
posts.tagline: AI builders: show what you spent, built, and earned
posts.description: AI is changing how we build products, but most founders don’t show the full picture. TokenGod is a public leaderboard where AI builders reveal their AI spend, revenue, products built, and return per $1. Create your public receipt, share your numbers, and let the internet decide: ❤️ Respect it 😂 Roast it Build it. Show the numbers.

posts.name: Frontier Index
posts.tagline: The terminal for frontier AI.
posts.description: Track every frontier AI model, benchmark and market move at one place, updated in real time.

posts.name: Klamp.ai
posts.tagline: Automate anything, instantly
posts.description: What if building a workflow was as simple as describing it? Klamp brings a prompt-based workflow builder to SaaS, turning your ideas into connected, automated workflows in minutes.

posts.name: Leanup v2.0
posts.tagline: calorie tracking with water logging ,fast tracking
posts.description: Download LeanUp, an AI calorie tracker app for meal logging, macro tracking, AI meal planning, food scanning, and smart nutrition insights.

posts.name: Osuite
posts.tagline: Root cause and a fix, in under five minutes
posts.description: Osuite is production intelligence for going from a P0 incident to RCA + fix in minutes. System breaks → runtime graph → AI investigation → root cause → fix → <5 min. Unlike traditional observability, Osuite correlates telemetry, code, deployments, and runtime context into a context mesh, giving both engineers and AI the context needed to investigate. An AI investigation agent works directly in your IDE, helping you understand what broke, why, and how to fix it.

posts.name: Scran
posts.tagline: Take the mental load out of cooking
posts.description: Scran is a mobile app that makes cooking easier and more accessible for neurodivergent cooks. Bring recipes from anywhere into a visual library, then simplify them into manageable tasks with prep upfront and ingredient amounts where you need them. Spend less energy following the recipe and more time enjoying the cooking.

posts.name: Voxide
posts.tagline: Let your AI voice assistant control your app.
posts.description: Voxide is a voice AI SDK for websites. Register your JavaScript functions as capabilities and a live voice agent calls them when users speak or type.

posts.name: Bindago
posts.tagline: AI for LinkedIn Outreach Personalisation
posts.description: Use Bindago AI message personalisation to send tailored LinkedIn connection requests and follow-ups at scale. Write once, personalise for every lead using real profile data.

posts.name: Screendrop
posts.tagline: Opensource screenshot + screen recording tool
posts.description: A beautiful screenshot + screen recording + Loom alternative - all native, self hostable and free. - fayazara/Screendrop

posts.name: WhiteBoard Ink - Explain
posts.tagline: Hand-drawn whiteboard explainers, in 60 seconds
posts.description: You explain things for a living. Type what you're getting across and who it's for. WhiteBoard Ink works out the structure and draws it,two finished hand-drawn whiteboard explainers, about a minute, six layouts. No canvas. Nothing to edit. Two free to try.

posts.name: SpecPilot
posts.tagline: Turn a chat into specs that keep AI coding on track
posts.description: Vibe coding starts strong but drifts as projects grow. SpecPilot turns a short chat into a completespecs/ workspace - 12 engineering files that keep Claude, Cursor, or Copilot aligned with your architecture from first prompt to production. No login, runs in your browser.

posts.name: Sarvam Stream
posts.tagline: What to Watch. Where to Watch. Made Simple.
posts.description: Sarvam Stream helps you discover what to watch and where to watch it across your favorite streaming services. Explore new releases, get personalized recommendations, find streaming availability, and keep track of your Watchlist and Watched titles—all in one place

posts.name: BrandCrew
posts.tagline: Your AI Marketing Crew, Always On.
posts.description: BrandCrew is your AI-powered marketing team in one command center. It monitors competitors and trends, creates on-brand content, helps you review and approve campaigns, publishes across channels, and learns from audience sentiment to improve what comes next. Built for teams that want to move from fragmented marketing workflows to supervised AI-powered execution.

posts.name: Pensatorium
posts.tagline: Speak your thoughts. Unlock order, actions and insights.
posts.description: Most thoughts usually get lost. Speak your thoughts — chaotic, half-formed, in the middle of a walk. Pensatorium does the rest. It structures what you said, connects threads across thoughts, and surfaces what you didn't notice. It organizes action items, and turns scheduled actions into calendar events automatically. Ask questions and it answers from your own thinking. Speak, and walk away with clarity, action, and a day that already knows what to do. Not a second brain. A thinking partner.

posts.name: Statecraft
posts.tagline: Create and edit user journeys in your real frontend
posts.description: Statecraft maps your product's real journeys from the live code then lets you change them directly and see the result instantly. Edit in the browser, your IDE, or with any AI.

posts.name: Drift
posts.tagline: Three hours a night is five years of your life
posts.description: Most people don't ruin their lives. They drift. No decision, no bad year - just evenings that went somewhere, until the somewhere became the life. Drift draws your life as about 4,170 weeks: the lived ones dark, the rest still yours. Three hours a night is five years of what's left. One honest tap a night. Five minutes on Sunday, then the week is sealed. Name what's running out - a parent you visit, a child at home - and Drift counts what's really left. No streaks. Nothing resets.

posts.name: Tablekard
posts.tagline: Powering Smarter Restaurants
posts.description: Tablekard connects diners, kitchens, staff, and restaurant owners through QR ordering, real-time queues, online payments, geofencing, and restaurant management tools.

posts.name: ReachFast
posts.tagline: Your next customers are already asking online
posts.description: ReachFast reads your website, Etsy shop, app page or freelance profile, understands what you sell and builds a profile of your target customer. Then it finds public posts on Reddit, X, LinkedIn and Facebook where people ask for exactly that. An AI judge scores every post for buying intent, so you get warm leads instead of keyword noise, fresh every 24 hours. No keywords, no linked accounts, no automated outreach: you reply as yourself and the conversation stays yours. 7 day free trial.

posts.name: In Bird Years
posts.tagline: How old would you be, as a bird?
posts.description: So at 34 you are a great tit on its second spring, holding a nest hole and a two-note song the whole street knows by heart. The same 34 makes you a raven on its sixth spring with a partner for life, and a yellow-tailed black-cockatoo still being fussed over by its parents. Age, it turns out, depends a lot on the wings.

posts.name: Metriva: Calorie & Weight Log
posts.tagline: Your private health data tracker
posts.description: Metriva is a comprehensive health tracking app that allows users to log food, macros, calories, and weight without requiring account creation or cloud synchronization. It offers features like a barcode scanner, nutrient tracking, and intermittent fasting timers, all while ensuring data privacy by storing information locally on your device. Ideal for those who want to maintain a healthy lifestyle with complete control over their personal data.

posts.name: Me in 10 Years
posts.tagline: Record a video. Receive it in 10 years.
posts.description: Most time-capsule apps are an email scheduler with a nicer UI. The hard part was never the video, it's making sure it reaches you a decade later. Uploads start the moment you pick a file. We collect a backup contact since emails die over 10 years. One price, 14-day refund, no subscription. Built to actually still be running in 2036, because that's the whole premise.

posts.name: Make Your Rakhi
posts.tagline: Design and share custom personalized Rakhis in minutes.
posts.description: Celebrate Raksha Bandhan with a personal touch! Make Your Rakhi lets you design custom, one-of-a-kind Rakhis. Choose from unique templates, add personal messages, or upload custom elements with our intuitive builder. We wanted to move past generic store-bought options and bring true personalization to the festival. Plus, with quick-commerce integration, your custom creation gets delivered reliably on time. Stand out this season with a Rakhi as unique as your bond!

posts.name: Fleets by Mridu AI
posts.tagline: The agent that reads you before it writes to you.
posts.description: Most LinkedIn tools automate sending. Fleets automates thinking first. Our trained models qualify every lead before a single message is written—no templates, no merge tags. The agent reads profiles deeply and writes something only that person would receive. Built as our own in-house B2B sales system. Human takeover when conversations get real. Managed profiles available. 50%+ acceptance, 35%+ reply from zero connections in 15 days.

posts.name: MyEscapePlan
posts.tagline: Find the best trip before choosing where or when
posts.description: Most travel sites make you choose a destination and fixed dates first. MyEscapePlan works backwards from the trip you want. It intelligently searches destinations and date combinations, weighs flights, accommodation, events, budget and preferences together, and learns from live travel signals to surface better options. It can also track escapes over time, helping you discover not just where to go, but when to go and which trip is actually worth taking. Try for free: https://myescapeplan.app

posts.name: OutbidMyAI
posts.tagline: Get your AI product to #1. Bid, climb, defend.
posts.description: OutbidMyAI is the public leaderboard where AI products compete for attention. Get listed for $1, climb the rankings by bidding higher, and defend your spot when someone outbids you. One-time bids, public rankings, no subscriptions — just a simple way to put your AI product in front of more people.

posts.name: RuleTheWorld
posts.tagline: Buy a country for $5. Get paid when someone takes it.
posts.description: RuleTheWorld is a public leaderboard of companies. 236 countries, one owner each. Take one for $5 and your logo, name and link sit on it. Anyone can outbid you for a dollar more, and when they do, you earn a commission on that sale and every sale after it.

posts.name: Famulor
posts.tagline: AI-native business calling
posts.description: Famulor combines AI voice agents with a complete business phone system. Answer inbound calls, run outbound campaigns, transfer calls to teammates, and continue conversations across 21 channels, including WhatsApp, email, SMS, Slack, Teams, and Telegram. Teams get web and mobile softphones, extensions, SIP device support, call queues, analytics, CRM integrations, and automated appointment booking. GDPR-ready workflows and EU hosting keep communication compliant.

posts.name: Superpower for Gemini
posts.tagline: Folders, queue, and prompt library for Google Gemini
posts.description: Gemini has no folders. Your sidebar is 50 untitled chats, and last week's work is gone. Superpower for Gemini adds folders, a prompt library, prompt chains, bulk export, a usage tracker, queue that sends your next message while Gemini is still typing and more. 30+ features. Everything runs on your device. Yes, it adds buttons to Google's clean UI. Every one has an off switch. 11,000+ users. 4.6 stars. Featured on the Chrome Web Store. Built by one person.

posts.name: Find your Strengths
posts.tagline: Paste your job description and figure out where you shine.
posts.description: Your strengths are already showing up in your work every week. Most people never see the pattern — so they keep grinding on the parts that drain them. The ones who pull ahead just made theirs visible. Paste in your job description, your weekly task list, or anything that captures what you actually do. In two minutes you'll have a clear map of where your strengths run deepest, which ones you're sitting on, and exactly what to do with them next... before someone else figures it out first.

posts.name: Windfall 2.0
posts.tagline: Track spending with Siri, Smart Entry, and calm budgets
posts.description: Windfall 2.0 is a major update to the private iPhone money tracker. Type a sentence, use Siri or Shortcuts, scan a receipt, or share a PDF invoice—then review the prepared merchant, amount, category, account, and date before saving. The new experience adds Liquid Glass, widgets, budgets, spending trends, heat maps, smart alerts, multi-currency totals, CSV export, and optional On Device Only parsing, without connecting a bank.

posts.name: NearoLeads - Local leads without website
posts.tagline: Local leads without website, delivered within 24 hours
posts.description: NearoLeads replaces searching manually on Google Maps for potential web development clients with a CSV lead lists for web agencies and freelancers. Choose a location and package and we will find local businesses listed on Google Maps without a website and deliver the list by email within 24 hours. Every lead includes a business name, phone number, category, and location.

posts.name: PageWisr
posts.tagline: Find what’s costing you customers, and fix it fast.
posts.description: Your website might look great and still lose customers. PageWisr finds what’s confusing, weak, or getting in the way across design, UX, copy, trust, SEO and more. Then it tells you exactly what to fix, why it matters, and gives you ready-to-use prompts to ship the changes. Your first website scan is completely free.

posts.name: Anthélie
posts.tagline: The climate ⇄ health atlas of climate-sensitive diseases
posts.description: Anthélie maps 124 climate-sensitive diseases: what climate favours, what protects — sourced thresholds across 22 indicators, evidence levels, instant climate profiles. Bilingual EN/FR, works offline as an installable web app, no account, no tracking. Built by a public health physician. €0.99 once — free trial with 3 complete sheets (dengue, heart attack, heat stroke).

posts.name: SwipeGallery - TikTok for Photos
posts.tagline: The addictive way to clean your camera roll
posts.description: You already spend half your day swiping through social media without even trying. SwipeGallery just points that same thumb muscle at your camera roll instead: up to keep, down to delete. Turns out the habit that ruins your screen time is great at fixing your storage. It remembers every choice, then everything you marked lands in a review grid so you can double check before anything actually disappears. All on your phone, nothing uploaded. Download for free, no account needed

posts.name: Speaker Copilot
posts.tagline: The stage timing copilot for live speakers
posts.description: Losing the clock mid-talk is every speaker's nightmare. Speaker Copilot runs your talk for you: auto-advancing timed sections, vibration cues, SOS rescue cards, Q&A phrase decks, rehearsal tracking. No login, no backend, open source.

posts.name: Speaker Copilot
posts.tagline: The stage timing copilot for live speakers
posts.description: Losing the clock mid-talk is every speaker's nightmare. Speaker Copilot runs your talk for you: auto-advancing timed sections, vibration cues, SOS rescue cards, Q&A phrase decks, rehearsal tracking. No login, no backend, open source.

posts.name: 1 Million Floors - a 3D Digital City
posts.tagline: Own a building in the world's first 3D digital city.
posts.description: 1MillionFloors is a 3D digital city where brands and individuals can own buildings and become part of an explorable virtual skyline. It reimagines the Million Dollar Homepage concept as an interactive 3D environment: instead of buying pixels on a finite 2D grid, you build a tower whose height determines its visibility. Explore the city, discover brands, and see how far the concept can scale when advertising space goes vertical.

posts.name: CodeHype
posts.tagline: Discover AI Tools, SaaS & Startup Launches
posts.description: Discover the latest AI tools, SaaS, agents, startups and developer products. Launch your AI product on CodeHype and get discovered by the AI community.

posts.name: Rhema-Voice - 100% Offline Dictation App
posts.tagline: Free, 100% Local ,Open-source Wispr Flow alternative
posts.description: Free, on-device dictation app for macOS. Press a key, talk, and your words paste at the cursor — local speech-to-text with Whisper, no cloud or subscription. An open-source Wispr Flow / superwhisper / Aqua Voice alternative that runs on older macOS (Ventura 13+). - ceosykes/rhema-voice

posts.name: aicoolies
posts.tagline: Hand-tested knowledge graph of AI developer tools
posts.description: aicoolies is a free Developer Tools Knowledge Graph: a hand-tested catalog of 1280+ AI developer tools with written comparisons, reviews, and curated stacks. Use it to choose coding agents, MCP gateways, inference runtimes, and the rest of a real toolchain. It is a catalog and decision surface, not a coding agent and not a scraped AI-tools dump.

posts.name: SociallyActive
posts.tagline: Plan Online Connect Offline
posts.description: SociallyActive is a social platform where you plan online and connect offline. We are redefining what social media is about. While social platforms are now overflowing with AI generated content and people, we are aiming to create real connections among real people in real life.

posts.name: Instashopsreview
posts.tagline: Reviews & scam alerts for Instagram shops
posts.description: InstaShopsReview is Google Reviews for Instagram shops, made by the people, for the people. DM-based sellers often dodge accountability — scammers just block you or hide your comment so no one else is warned. Search any shop by its Instagram handle to see 1-5 star ratings, written reviews, and photos from real buyers before you order. A Scam Alert section flags known scammers, so you know who to avoid, and helps you discover great local shops too

posts.name: jip.ai
posts.tagline: Non-profit kids' game portal
posts.description: jip.ai is a game platform for kids with no ads, no purchases and no accounts. Small, fast browser games, a profile per kid, a daily limit, and a screen time page for parents.

posts.name: bundl.link
posts.tagline: One link, made to feel like home
posts.description: Bring your links and work together on one page that feels like yours. Build your link-in-bio page with bundl and start for free.

posts.name: Plainspeak
posts.tagline: A Voice layer for AI agents to write like a human.
posts.description: We are fed up with unnecessarily long and complex replies from AI agents. I created plainspeak to solve this problem. Plainspeak gives your agent a small set of writing rules that run on every reply: plain words, short sentences, direct language, no filler, and no em dashes. Install it once and your agent keeps the voice automatically. Works with Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, OpenCode, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, and other agents. Open source. MIT licensed. No API key.

posts.name: Nyvra Studio
posts.tagline: Transform your photos with AI, 3D depth, and smart effects
posts.description: Nyvra Studio is a powerful desktop AI photo editor for Windows. Transform flat images with 3D depth, atmospheric mist, and background bokeh. Use the Smart Lasso (powered by Meta's SAM) for instant object masking, and polish your shots with professional HSL controls, cinematic presets, and live RGB histograms. Built with Python and PyTorch for creators who want high-end AI editing on their desktop. Download and explore today!

posts.name: Neoswarm
posts.tagline: Neovim for controlling ai agents at 10x productivity
posts.description: A terminal alternative for controlling ai agents at scale inspired by neovim. Minimal, stylish ui with good keybindings so you never have to touch the mouse again. Fully configurable and extendable with plugins. Supports every major cli, use it with your own AI plans. Replacement for paseo, conductor, paseo and every other GUI tools.

posts.name: Arrow Domino: Tap Away Puzzle
posts.tagline: Tap one arrow, topple the whole board like dominoes
posts.description: Arrow Domino is a tap-away arrow puzzle with a twist no other game has: a fired arrow triggers the arrows it hits, so a single tap sets off a chain reaction across the whole board. The puzzle isn't tapping everything. It's finding where the chain starts. 651 handcrafted, solver-verified levels across nine chapters layer in color fusion, splitters, swaps, bombs, ghosts, walls, redirector pads and portals, one new rule at a time. Free, plays fully offline, and no forced ads ever.

posts.name: Perpetua
posts.tagline: Find and organize the accounts your family may one day need
posts.description: Most people estimate they have 40 online accounts. Perpetua surfaces an average of 154. We analyze the metadata associated with your inbox and online presence to surface banks, subscriptions, utilities, and other service accounts, without ever accessing the contents of your emails. In ~20 minutes, build a private account map and leave your family a playbook for accessing what they need in an emergency.

posts.name: IRL Party
posts.tagline: Make the room the main event
posts.description: Turn any room into an interactive party. Guests join from their phones and everyone plays together on the big screen.

posts.name: WHORL
posts.tagline: Turn any sound into a rhythmic sequence.
posts.description: Analyzes transients and spectral weight in any sample, splits it into 3 slice types (attacks, bodies, textures), then sequences them across a 16-step grid. No manual chopping. Drag in a file and start sequencing. Auto-slice audio into 3 categories (A/B/C) 16-step grid, 1/32 subdivisions, sustain ties, generative randomization Step FX matrix: Distortion, Filter, Delay, Reverse, Tape Stop, Auto-Pan 4 pattern memory slots via MIDI VST3 + AU + Standalone,

Assign every dollar, automate recurring income and bills, spot cash shortfalls up to 90 days ahead, and review 6- or 12-month trends. Your data stays on device—no bank connection, account, ads, or tracking. Full backup, restore, and CSV export remain free. Try all Pro features for 30 days with no card, then choose Annual or Lifetime.

posts.name: Notepik

Every action item includes a suggested owner and due date, so nothing gets lost after the call. Search across every meeting, discuss transcript moments with your team, and push tasks directly into Slack, Asana, Trello, or ClickUp. Walls also shows exactly what your bar actually plays, ranked by how often, with video tools to learn any dance before you walk in. Live on web and iOS. Android in beta.

posts.name: Nacre - AI Context Layer
posts.tagline: Permission-aware context for AI agents, self-hosted
posts.description: Nacre is a self-hosted knowledge index for AI agents, where permission is part of retrieval rather than a filter bolted on after it. An agent acts for a person and reaches only what that person may read: the access check runs inside the index traversal, so results are never trimmed afterwards. Connect over MCP or REST, run it with Docker in two minutes, keep every document on your own machine. Apache 2.0 - and a live demo where one query gives three people three different answers.

posts.description: Free! I got the tokens so let's burn em. No account. So Sign up. No Payment. You can't even pay if you wanted because Stripe isn't connected. Takeover is the best feature - inside a conversation @getsme to add to the chat... then /takeover and set a goal and the agent will work towards that until it is complete... Text/Voice/Image etc... Try Takeover! Chat, remember, create, plan, schedule reminders and manage selected one-to-one replies with Gets.me inside Telegram.

posts.name: Shuki
posts.tagline: Minimal macOS menu bar Pomodoro. No stats, no dashboards.
posts.description: Shuki is a Pomodoro timer for the macOS menu bar. No stats, no charts, no cycle history — nothing extra to pull you away from the work you actually want to do. Handcrafted sounds, custom focus and recharge lengths, and only the notifications you want. Launch at login and it stays in the menu bar. Named after Japanese 周期 (shūki), meaning cycle. Free on the Mac App Store.
